scope: Natural relative Blender-unit bending and sag for indexed line families

fixed.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

formed_metal.shape_rule: retains bent metal shape, tiny unsupported bow
formed_metal.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

semi_rigid.shape_rule: curved polymer or annealed tube remembers a shape
semi_rigid.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

spring_metal_flex.shape_rule: metal interlocking helix retains visible spring stiffness
spring_metal_flex.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

corrugated_polymer.shape_rule: distributed polymer corrugation bends, not a sharp elbow
corrugated_polymer.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

flex_polymer.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

soft_hose.shape_rule: soft drape; centerline cannot collapse bore
soft_hose.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

reinforced_hose.shape_rule: reinforcement limits tight bends and droop
reinforced_hose.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

spring_guarded.shape_rule: coiled reinforcement pitch independent of path shape
spring_guarded.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

loose_wire.shape_rule: small wire hangs naturally between fixed terminals
loose_wire.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

loose_bundle.shape_rule: independent core sag from shared coherent bundle frame
loose_bundle.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

flex_bundle.shape_rule: moderate group sag with independent core slack between ties
flex_bundle.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

twisted_bundle.shape_rule: group droop plus continuous twisted-pair lay
twisted_bundle.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

jacketed_cable.shape_rule: cable jacket bows as a coherent tube; inner cores fan only at terminals
jacketed_cable.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

high_flex_cord.shape_rule: soft gravity-like drape, fixed terminal seats
high_flex_cord.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

ribbon_flex.shape_rule: main bending around flat ribbon preferred axis
ribbon_flex.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

tensioned.shape_rule: near-straight taut line with no hose-like catenary
tensioned.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

rope_soft.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

segmented_joint.shape_rule: bending occurs at constrained articulated joints
segmented_joint.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

formed_rebar.shape_rule: solid bar, no unsupported sag; explicitly authored bends only
formed_rebar.units: dimensionless visual controls; not real-world stiffness

wire_bundle_variation.endpoint_invariant: all public sockets exact; internal core exits may be offset INSIDE fixed outlet envelope
wire_bundle_variation.topology_invariant: no wire may move shared public socket; no identical line overlays
wire_bundle_variation.collision_policy: bound pair spacing and curvature; flag obvious core self-intersection, never random spaghetti

stiffness_selection: architecture default may be overridden per sample; permission required for unsupported physical combinations
